notes_extra: Same GT and 30 in Bartlein. Jul 27: 2857 fps, SD 2.6, and 2850 fps was on at 1000 yards with 23.5 MOA. Aug 6: 2850-2860 fps. Oct 13: 2860 fps. On Jul 23, 35.7 gr was just starting to flatten a primer; the Jul 27 brass showed no pressure signs.

author: Steve Donlon
notes_extra: Groups 3/8 to 5/16 in at 100 yards. On Aug 11, 2026 he wrote 2860+ fps at 35.8 gr, and on Aug 14 he said 35.8 gr was 3 fps from 35.7 gr. 30 in Bartlein 1:7.5. He calls the rifle his GT. The thread is 6mmGT.

author: cp255
notes_extra: 28 in Krieger 1.25 in straight, 7.5 twist. Tested 10 and 20 thou off the lands. Cratering and clickers around 33.5 gr. He planned to run 32.8 gr and expected around 2760 fps. That figure is not a chronograph reading. His 105 hybrid at 2925 fps is a different bullet.

author: ratguner

author: ELR LVR

author: ELR LVR
